messages:
toni: Heads-up: external pen tester (BlackHarbor) wants a short onboarding Wed 09:30 PST for staging. Scope includes API and infra stacks. They need a KMS keywrap proof and read-only for logs. Can we finalize by EOD?
rahul: Prefer kms-proxy + ephemeral role. No direct key material. We'll provision alias/pt-306789 with GenerateDataKeyEncrypted only.
infra: ok to create alias with TTL. infra-owner sign-off required though. I'll ping @kelly offline for approval; fallback is timeboxed alias with audit note.
toni: RBAC: create group pt-306789-assessors and role assessor-staging-readonly. Least privilege: s3:GetObject, logs:GetLogEvents, execute-api:Invoke (kms-proxy). No IAM:PassRole. Role sessions <=4h, MFA required.
rahul: Audit: enable 100% sampling for api-traces and auth-events for the test window. Add header X-Pentest-ID:pt-306789 to all ingested logs. Persist signed snapshots to s3://pt-evidence/306789/ with server-side KMS=alias/pt-306789.
oncall: I'll run the bridge and include retest slots on calendar. Please add the runbook link to the thread.
sec-bot: CI check scheduled at 17:00. Will verify bucket policies and role constraints; will post result here.
toni: Remediation workflow: I'll create JIRA epic PT-306789 and sub-tasks for critical/high/medium. SLA: Crit=10d, High=30d, Med=60d. Assign remediation-squad by default and require proof-of-fix steps.
rahul: Pre-retest dry-run: vendor to get ephemeral creds, call kms-proxy for GenerateDataKeyEncrypted, fetch logs, request presigned export. We'll sign manifest with HSM: `openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /etc/hsm/pt_306789.pem manifest.json | base64`
infra: blocker: awaiting infra-owner sign-off for alias creation. If no sign-off by 18:00, we'll provision a TTL alias and annotate audit.
toni: ok team, finalize RBAC and log pipeline by EOD. I'll post runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/pt/306789 and JIRA once created.
